verdict.rationale: Building custom agents is a fair question for a project-management SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a REST API, an MCP server for connecting external agents (Codex CLI, Cursor, Claude Code), and tracking agent work. These are developer building blocks or external-agent integrations, not an in-product way to build and configure your own agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product
